data.situation: Two weeks later, Lin had an exam at the end of the first course unit. She entered the central library through the main doors and found a quiet desk near the window. A textbook lay in the middle of the desk beside her old class notes. She began her revision by covering the notes and trying to explain the main ideas. One page about sharing project costs still confused her. Reading it again did not tell her why two figures were different. She wrote the figures on a blue question card to the right of the book. She sent a short message to her tutor asking for help with that example. The reply offered a tutorial for three students the next morning. Lin added the time to the question card and brought both the card and the textbook. In the small room, the tutor asked her to explain where she got stuck. Together they traced which costs were shared and which belonged to one person. Back at the library, Lin tried a new example without the notes. She could now say what the figures meant.
data.zhSupport: revision 只选原来源考前复习义，不教修改文稿义。先独立看书找出问题，再在小组辅导课求助；tutorial 与上一课讨论课的用途通过具体事件呈现。

retrievalPrompts.cue: A friend asks why you are looking at the course material again. Say what you are doing and what you are getting ready for.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 朋友问你为什么又在看课程材料。说明你正在复习，以及要准备什么。
acceptableAnswers: I am doing revision to prepare for an exam.
My revision will help me prepare for an exam.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Name the exam purpose. Here the noun means studying again, not changing a draft.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 交代考试目的；这里的名词是重新学习，不是修改文稿。

retrievalPrompts.cue: Tell a classmate where on campus you study and which standard course book you are using.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 告诉同学，你在校园哪个主要图书馆学习，以及使用什么标准课程书。
acceptableAnswers: I study in the central library and use the textbook.
I take my textbook to the central library to study.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Give both the place and the study material.

retrievalPrompts.cue: The example has two different cost figures. Tell your teacher exactly what you cannot explain yet.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 例子里有两个不同的费用数字。告诉教师你还无法解释什么。
acceptableAnswers: I still do not understand why these figures are different.
I still do not understand the difference between these two figures.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Point to the difficulty so the teacher can give focused help.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 指出具体困难，让教师可以有针对性地帮助。

transferPrompt.function: Ask for help beyond the course
transferPrompt.cue: At a workplace safety session, two instructions seem to conflict. Tell the trainer what you do not understand yet.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 换到工作安全培训：两条说明似乎有冲突。告诉培训者你还不明白什么。
acceptableAnswers: I still do not understand why these two instructions are different.
I still do not understand which instruction I should follow.
transferPrompt.feedback: Use the same help request with new information instead of copying the number problem.
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 把同一求助表达用于新信息，不照搬数字问题。
